title: Buckminster Fuller and the Long View
short_teaser: After a period of personal crisis, Buckminster Fuller committed himself to exploring how design might serve humanity.
story: After a period of personal crisis, Buckminster Fuller committed himself to exploring how design might serve humanity. His work ranged across architecture, systems, and resource use. A life can change direction when a person chooses to make usefulness the organizing question. A person’s story becomes useful when it helps us recognize choices, courage, persistence, and possibility in our own life. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
